title: Clean-Up Timer Quest
description: Rescue a toy-filled room by matching every object to its picture-marked home.
learningGoals: Sort objects by a concrete category
interactionModel: drag an object to its matching picture-marked home, or tap the object and then its home
feedbackModel: spoken prompts, tactile placement feedback, a musical pacing timer, and a sparkling room transformation

modes.title: Playroom Rescue
modes.skill: sort plush friends and wooden blocks by picture

modes.title: Bedroom Rescue
modes.skill: sort clothes and books by picture

modes.title: Living Room Rescue
modes.skill: sort wheeled toys and music toys by picture
